BombVault 10.3.1 can keep the newest ZFS replica snapshots on the source too, and an orange line in the log says why it is orange.

## ✨ Added

- **Keep replica snapshots on the source too.** The Replica card of a ZFS entry has a new field, **Keep on this server**. It sets how many of the newest replica snapshots stay on the source after each replica, next to the ones the target keeps. Their files can be read or copied right away from `.zfs/snapshot` or a clone. Rolling a dataset back to an older one needs `zfs release` on the newest first, and the copy on the target then goes back to the newest snapshot both sides still share, which the failed replica names. The documentation has the commands. 0 or 1 keeps only the newest, as before. ([#359](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/discussions/359))

## 🐛 Fixed

- **An orange line in the log says why it is orange.** A backup that went through but left something out, such as data outside Host Data or files it could not read, turned its line orange without a word. The line names what was left out and the folders or files behind it, every note of the run in your language. ([#377](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/377))

## 🌐 Translations

- **The new texts in all 42 languages**, and the documentation in all 26.
